messages:
pat: heads-up: customer Nimbus asked for an observability canary to track token errors + cost delta. timeline = 2 weeks?
lee: propose MVP: single dashboard card (errors/s), tracing hook emitting error_code + span_id, sampling flag per-customer.
tess: agree. add rollout gating: security review, cost smoke <4%, 1 customer canary.
security: need redaction + retention policy. no raw tokens in spans.
pat: noted. action items: lee build api flag + trace payload (2d), tess mock dashboard (1d), security write redaction signoff (3d).
ops-bot: reminder: add canary alert when daily cost delta >3%.
pat: i'll draft customer note about data collected and retention (14 days).
lee: also adding API: POST /v1/traces?sample=1.0 for canary.
tess: can we show cost-per-slice card only initially? keeps scope small.
pat: yes. schedule demo with Nimbus in week 2. closing.
